events.quote: 不過我覺得這個是原因的一環，因為 GameStop 它其實在前陣子到現在，就已經一路在上漲了。
events.quote_en: But I think this is part of the reason, because GameStop had actually been rising steadily from a while ago until now.

events.quote: 他真的就算是一個正向指標，因為他喊水會結凍，他要買什麼、他要看什麼，他要看 Etsy、他要看 Signal、他要看比特幣，那這些東西就跟著漲了。
events.quote_en: He really is a positive indicator, because whatever he says moves markets: whatever he wants to buy or look at, Etsy, Signal, Bitcoin, those things rise along with it.

events.quote: 再來就是 MicroStrategy，這老闆是一個比特幣的大多頭，持有很大量的比特幣，也跟著就是一直在漲。
events.quote_en: Next is MicroStrategy. Its boss is a big Bitcoin bull and holds a huge amount of Bitcoin, and it has kept rising along with it.

events.quote: 就是 Square 七成、PayPal 兩成、Affirm 一成，是最近三個波動都還蠻大的，所以那個比例已經跑掉了，但是初始我是這樣放。
events.quote_en: That's 70% Square, 20% PayPal and 10% Affirm. All three have been pretty volatile lately, so the weights have drifted, but that's how I set it up initially.

events.quote: 他認為像是 IBM 就是一個，Oracle 就是一個，就是你已經沒有能力再去創造出新的東西了，那這樣的公司就不會是一個好的投資標的。
events.quote_en: He thinks IBM is one, Oracle is one: when you no longer have the ability to create new things, a company like that won't be a good investment.

events.quote: 像臉書就是抄襲 Snapchat，然後做了 Instagram 的 Story，這個就從 Snapchat 抄來的。所以其實抄來抄去是很正常的，很多時候是這樣。
events.quote_en: Facebook copied Snapchat and made Instagram Stories, which was copied from Snapchat. So copying each other is very normal; it happens a lot.

events.quote: 那再來石油股就是他有買像是雪佛龍。那其實在上一集節目有跟大家提到說，我比較不喜歡他這樣的東西。
events.quote_en: Then in oil stocks he bought Chevron. In the last episode I told everyone I don't really like that kind of thing.

events.quote: 那在台灣這……不在台灣，在歐洲這邊是透過 Vodafone。就像是台灣的 Netflix 是透過中華電信，台灣大哥大像是 Disney+。
events.quote_en: In Taiwan this… not in Taiwan, in Europe it goes through Vodafone. Just like Netflix in Taiwan goes through Chunghwa Telecom, and Taiwan Mobile has Disney+.

events.quote: …額外介紹兩支，所以我把它補充到臉書上面，就是 iShares 的 BlackRock，它下面有兩個 ETF 也是做價值型的，一個是 IVE，一個是 IJS。
events.quote_en: …I'll introduce two more, so I added them on Facebook: iShares by BlackRock has two ETFs that are also value funds, one is IVE and one is IJS.

events.quote: 那我們剛剛講到這個疫苗的部分，我跟大家分享一下，就是 AstraZeneca，他們現在歐洲很多在打 AZ 的疫苗。
events.quote_en: We just talked about vaccines, so let me share: AstraZeneca. Many people in Europe are now getting the AZ vaccine.

events.quote: 那持股就是比方說像是什麼騰訊、阿里巴巴、京東、拼多多、美團，反正就是你說能想到的公司。
events.quote_en: The holdings are things like Tencent, Alibaba, JD, Pinduoduo, Meituan; basically every company you can think of.

events.quote: …跟大家聊一下中國的新疆棉事件，目前有越來越多的藝人去參與，包含中國、香港或是台灣的，都有去抵制 Nike、Adidas 等等的品牌，簡單來講就說他們辱華了。
events.quote_en: …let's talk about China's Xinjiang cotton incident. More and more celebrities, from China, Hong Kong and Taiwan, are boycotting brands like Nike and Adidas; simply put, they say those brands insulted China.

events.quote: 而且賠回去可能不只是只有你賠錢，比方說這些讓他融資的銀行，像是瑞信、野村，或是說是摩根史坦利（大摩）、高盛（Goldman Sachs）等等。
events.quote_en: And when it unwinds, it may not be just you losing money, but also the banks that lent him margin, like Credit Suisse, Nomura, or Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs.

events.quote: 那日月光呢，就是封測的龍頭也是讚，也是說好。面板的友達也是說讚。
events.quote_en: ASE, the leader in packaging and testing, also says it's good. The panel maker AUO also says it's good.

events.quote: 可是即便是這樣子，那我就先問你一個問題，在歐洲跟美國疫情最高峰的時候，請問你有沒有看到英飛凌、恩智浦、STM，還是說這個德州儀器、Intel 有停工？
events.quote_en: Even so, let me ask you one question: at the peak of the pandemic in Europe and the US, did you see Infineon, NXP, STM, Texas Instruments or Intel stop production?

events.quote: …來說，像美國的 AVGO、QCOM，還有這個，別說像是 MRVL，這些在做網通的，那在做這個射頻相關的，高通、Skyworks，你根本就不知道他媽老闆是誰。
events.quote_en: …for example, in the US there's AVGO, QCOM, and also MRVL, the networking ones; and in RF, Qualcomm and Skyworks. You have no idea who their bosses are.

events.quote: 但是當然有些人喜歡，有些人不喜歡，像可口可樂跟百事可樂，有些人喜歡，有些人不喜歡。
events.quote_en: Of course some people like it and some don't, like Coca-Cola and Pepsi: some people like them, some don't.

events.quote: 你品牌廠那邊，戴爾那邊也是很可怕，你這個 component，完全沒有人叫貨，很可怕的事情。
events.quote_en: On the brand side, Dell is in scary shape too: nobody is ordering your components at all. It's frightening.

events.quote: Podcast 上次說 9 月 9 號要被世人記住，是因為 Novavax 事件。」
events.quote_en: "Last time the podcast said September 9 would be remembered by the world because of the Novavax event."

events.quote: 那同時呢，Apple、美國銀行、美國運通，然後 Kraft Heinz 以及 Coca-Cola，這些主要持股是沒有去做動作的。
events.quote_en: Meanwhile, the major holdings Apple, Bank of America, American Express, Kraft Heinz and Coca-Cola were left untouched.

events.quote: 那同時他也提高了 Invesco、GoDaddy 等等的持股，然後減碼了 Intuit、Applied Materials，以及 Target 等等的持股。
events.quote_en: At the same time he raised holdings in Invesco, GoDaddy and others, and trimmed Intuit, Applied Materials, Target and others.

events.quote: …功率半導體，基本上就是掌握在所謂五大廠裡面，像是什麼安森美、英飛凌、恩智浦、瑞薩、意法半導體（STM）這樣的大公司，IDM，他們其實掌握了大多數的功率半導體…
events.quote_en: …power semiconductors are basically controlled by the big five: onsemi, Infineon, NXP, Renesas and STMicroelectronics (STM). These big IDMs control most power semiconductors…

events.quote_en: The biggest is Coinbase at 1.58%, then Unity, and Tesla is in there too at only 1.3%, then Spotify, Teradyne…

events.quote_en: …then Tesla is in there too at only 1.3%, then Spotify, Teradyne, the automation company, and number ten is Nvidia at 1.13%.
